title: Trip
description: One work session. The record of what happened. PRD-2 section 3.3.

routeId.description: A SNAPSHOT of vans.routeId at shift start. If the office reassigns the van mid-shift, today's trip keeps its scope.

driverId.description: The CONFIRMED driver code. The office's accountability field. This is a claim value, never a badge code the client sent.

wardIds.description: A SNAPSHOT of the driver's allotment at shift start. The D4 complaint rule scopes on this. A mid-shift change to the allotment does not rewrite today's record.

date.description: The IST midnight instant of the shift's day. NOT a date string. Both reads and writes build the window in the write frame.

startedAt.description: Client clock. A known weakness. The server-computed date field is added alongside, not replacing, this one.

endedAt.description: Null while the shift is live.

wardsDone.description: The wards recorded as collected. Out-of-order marks are allowed.

flagged.description: True when the driver marked the ward done from outside its radius. A tamper signal for the office.

alertedWardIds.description: The arrival-alert bookkeeping. THE IDEMPOTENCY GUARD. Without it, the 10-second location cadence sends a push every 10 seconds.

gpsTrail.description: The location trail. THE 1 MiB CLIFF. A Firestore document is capped at 1 MiB, so the trail is SHARDED into trips/{id}/trail subcollection documents. This array is the legacy shape.

mockLocationDetected.description: A one-way latch. Once true it stays true. The office should be pushed.
